issues.detail: The Greek 'ηλικιαν εχει αυτον ερωτησατε' is a reported speech construction where the parents are saying 'Ask him, he has reached age' (or 'he is of age'). The Vietnamese translation 'Nó đã có tuổi' (It/He already has age) is slightly awkward but the major issue is the omission of the interrogative/imperative force of 'ερωτησατε'. More importantly, 'ηλικιαν εχει' in this context implies 'he is of age/old enough', which is slightly different from just 'having age'.
